title: Alma Observations of Massive Molecular Gas Filaments Encasing Radio Bubbles in the Phoenix Cluster
question: How is the molecular gas in the Phoenix cluster central galaxy distributed and moving relative to the radio bubbles, and is it consistent with free-fall?

data.bands: CO(3-2) at 216.66 GHz plus continuum basebands at 219.5, 230.5, 232.5 GHz
data.sensitivity: 0.3 mJy/beam per 12 km/s channel; continuum 0.019 mJy/beam

what.value: Chandra X-ray cavity properties and cavity enthalpy

evidence.quote: the cavity enthalpy was estimated as $4.4-6.7\times10^{59}\rm\; erg$

what.value: Effective radius ~17 kpc from HST imaging

evidence.quote: determine an effective radius of $\sim17\rm\; kpc$ from HST imaging in five photometric bands
The strong velocity gradients in the molecular gas are comparable to those observed for the warm ionized gas ((cite: McDonald14)).

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image CO(3-2) cube and continuum
recipe.method: CASA pipeline calibration, CLEAN with natural weighting, UVCONTSUB, 12 km/s channels
Three Gaussian components fitted to spectrum from 6x6 arcsec region

recipe.goal: Map velocity and FWHM per pixel
recipe.method: Beam-sized region spectra fitted with 1-3 Gaussians, 3 sigma detection from 1000 Monte Carlo simulations
Mass from integrated CO intensity with XCO and line ratio

recipe.goal: Compare PV diagram with Hernquist free-fall
recipe.method: Free-fall velocity in Hernquist potential with NFW-derived total mass, several inclinations, initial velocity 250 km/s
assumptions: Hydrostatic spherical atmosphere; Re ~17 kpc, a=9.4 kpc

evidence.quote: For the integrated CO(3-2) intensity of $8.9\pm1.5\hbox{$\rm\; Jy\rm\; km\rm\; s^{-1}\,$}$
the total molecular gas mass is $2.1\pm0.3\times10^{10}\hbox{$\rm\thinspace M_{\odot}$}$
has a molecular gas mass of $1.0\pm0.2\times10^{10}\hbox{$\rm\thinspace M_{\odot}$}$
with a flux of $2.5\pm0.1\rm\; mJy$ at $225.09\rm\; GHz$
We therefore estimate a galaxy total mass of $\sim2\times10^{13}\hbox{$\rm\thinspace M_{\odot}$}$ within a radius of $\sim50\rm\; kpc$.

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channels for continuum subtraction and continuum fit order
CLEAN threshold, mask, cell and image size
Exact regions for filaments and hybrid spatial/spectral flux separation
Initial guesses and bounds for MPFIT component fits and how components are assigned
Hernquist model inputs per filament (initial radius, inclination grid details)
Luminosity distance value used in mass calculation
score_reason: Public data and clear outline but many parameters missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public archival dataset, numeric results (flux, mass), moderately complete recipe.
